system.description:
You leap to the top of your polearm, standing and balancing atop it. Depending on how much you put into it, the slam will be gloriously savage. Choose the Actions you want to invest when this jutsu is cast.

Action. Make a melee Taijutsu attack against a creature in range, dealing your [Weapons damage] + 8d6 and you can leap to a space that can hold you up to 20 feet away.

Action + Bonus Action. Same as an Action, but the affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw being Staggered on a failed save.

Action + Reaction. Same as an Action, but the affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw becoming vulnerable to the next instance of damage from a creature other than yourself before the end of your next turn.

Action + Bonus Action + Reaction. Same as Action, but the affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw becoming Stunned on a failed save. Additionally, the Stunned creature becomes vulnerable to the next instance of damage they take from a creature other than yourself before the end of your next turn.

Chain 2: When you land in your chosen space, if there are any hostile creatures adjacent to you, you can make a melee taijutsu attack targeting one of them, dealing your [Weapons damage] on a hit.

Chain 3: If you invest your Action, Bonus Action and Reaction into casting this jutsu and the affected creature fails their saving throw, you regain your Action. If you use this regained action to cast a Jutsu you gain 2 ranks of Exhaustion.
